data.name: Menu.Rendering.OffByDefaultSinceExtraRendering
data.value: Off by default, since this is an extra rendering pass on top of Roblox.

data.name: Menu.Rendering.WhichShaderTechniqueApplyOnceOverlay
data.value: Which shader technique to apply once the overlay is enabled.

data.value: Shader-based motion interpolation drawn in a click-through overlay above the game window. This does not improve actual FPS or reduce input lag - it only makes motion look smoother, mainly useful on low end PCs. Leave it off on mid range or high end systems.

data.name: Menu.Rendering.InterpolatesExtraFrameBetweenRealCaptured
data.value: Interpolates an extra frame between real captured frames while you're in game.

data.name: Menu.Rendering.HigherQualityCostsMoreGPUTime
data.value: Higher quality costs more GPU time per interpolated frame. 0 = Fast, 1 = Balanced, 2 = Quality.

data.name: Menu.Rendering.GPUTimerPowerPlanTweaksApplied

data.name: Menu.Rendering.ForceSpecificGameResolutionChosenMonitor

data.name: Menu.Rendering.AddMoreStatRowsBelowFPS
data.value: Add more stat rows below FPS - each is shown as its own line on the same HUD panel.

data.name: Menu.Rendering.TotalSystemCPUUsageAllCores
data.value: Total system CPU usage, all cores.

data.name: Menu.Rendering.RoundTripTimeCurrentGameServer
data.value: Round-trip time to the current game server. Shows -- if the server's address isn't known yet.

data.name: Menu.Rendering.InstantlyHidesHUDCrosshairWithoutTurning

data.name: Menu.Rendering.WhileHUDCrosshairAreHiddenRegardless
data.value: While on, the HUD and crosshair are hidden regardless of their own toggles above.

data.name: Menu.Rendering.OverrideWhetherHUDCrosshairShowUp
data.value: Override whether the HUD and crosshair show up in specific games, regardless of the global toggles above.

data.value: Turn the vignette on or off.

data.value: Crop, draw, add text or pixelate parts of this screenshot

data.value: How many frames per second the clip records. Anything above 30 fps needs Roblox to be the window you are playing in, and tops out at your monitor's refresh rate and the game's own frame rate. If the PC cannot keep up, the clip simply has fewer frames - it never plays too fast.

data.name: Menu.Capture.NativeRecordsGameAtExactlySize
data.value: Native records the game at exactly the size it is running at (1920 x 1080 on a 1080p screen). Pick a lower option to scale clips down and save memory and disk space.

data.name: Menu.Capture.PictureQualitySavedClipHigherMeans
data.value: Picture quality of the saved clip. Higher means a higher bitrate: sharper video, bigger files.

data.name: Menu.Capture.TrimCropSlowDownSpeedUp
data.value: Trim, crop, slow down or speed up this clip, or save a frame from it as a screenshot

data.name: Menu.FastFlagEditor.OnlyRowsYouHaveHighlightedFlag
data.value: Only the rows you have highlighted in the flag list go into the preset. Click a row to select it, Ctrl+click to add more, Shift+click for a range. Best for turning a few flags into a per-game bundle.

data.name: Menu.FastFlagEditor.EveryFlagCurrentlyListGoesInto
data.value: Every flag currently in the list goes into the preset, no selection needed. Best for snapshotting your whole setup, or making all of it apply only where assigned.

data.name: Menu.FastFlagEditor.OnlyUsePresetSFlagsWhere
data.value: Only use the preset's flags where it is assigned

data.name: Menu.FastFlagEditor.WhenPresetCreatedFromSelectedFlags
data.value: When a preset is created (from the selected flags, or from all of them), its flags are removed from your global list so they no longer apply to every game. Leave off to keep them global as well.

data.name: Menu.FastFlagEditor.ChangeAddRemoveFlagsInsidePreset
data.value: Change, add or remove the flags inside this preset

data.name: Menu.Integrations.NamesActivityPhasmaStrapShowsFromMoment
data.value: Names the activity PhasmaStrap, shows it from the moment Roblox opens (an idle card with the logo while you're in the Roblox app), and puts the logo as the badge on the game icon while in a game (the account avatar takes that badge instead when "Show account on profile" is on). Off behaves like Bloxstrap: "Playing Roblox", in-game only. Applies to the next session.

data.name: Menu.Appearance.ClickPictureUseImagesAnimatedGIFs
data.value: Click a picture to use it. Images and animated GIFs are copied into PhasmaStrap, so they keep working if you move or delete the original. Changes are saved straight away.

data.name: Menu.FastFlagEditor.RestartRobloxWhenPresetCouldnT
data.value: Close Roblox first when pressing Play needs a different preset

data.name: Menu.FastFlagEditor.RobloxOnlyReadsFastFlagsWhenStarts
data.value: Roblox only reads FastFlags when it starts. If it is already open when you press Play in the browser, it takes the join over and the game's preset is never read. With this on, PhasmaStrap closes the running Roblox first in that case, so the game starts with its preset. Off by default. PhasmaStrap never restarts Roblox on its own: when you join a game whose preset isn't active (from inside the Roblox app, or by following a friend), you only get a notification - click it if you want to restart into the same server with the preset.

data.value: Shows the PhasmaStrap mark instead of the Roblox logo on the round menu button at the top left of every game. Applied when Roblox starts, and kept across Roblox updates. Turn it off to get the Roblox logo back on the next launch.
